questions.prompt: What does interleaving mainly strengthen in this chapter?
choices: Recognition and selection among similar cases
Comfort during the practice session
The value of randomness by itself

explanation.gentle: Interleaving matters because it helps the learner tell similar cases apart and choose the right response.
explanation.direct: The chapter treats discrimination, not novelty, as the core mechanism of mixed practice.
explanation.competitive: Interleaving trains the chooser, not the lover of chaos.

questions.prompt: Why can blocked practice mislead the learner?
choices: Because repetition never helps at all
Because the block can make the next move too obvious
Because mixed practice is always more enjoyable

explanation.gentle: The block itself can hint which response belongs next, so the learner may look stronger than later performance will be.
explanation.direct: Blocked practice can improve current fluency while hiding weak classification and later choice.
explanation.competitive: The drill can leak the category and let repetition impersonate mastery.

questions.prompt: Why might a mixed algebra packet help more than grouped problem types?
choices: It forces the student to identify which method fits each problem
It removes the need for understanding
It guarantees fewer mistakes in the session

explanation.gentle: A mixed packet asks the learner to recognize the problem type before solving.
explanation.direct: Interleaving helps because it turns category recognition into part of practice instead of leaving it to the test.
explanation.competitive: The packet stops giving away the move and makes the chooser work.

questions.prompt: What did Victor's postmortem reveal about blocked script training?
choices: It made the support calls too short
It trained repetition more than case recognition
It worked perfectly outside the drill

explanation.gentle: The team looked fluent in order but weaker once the case types stopped repeating in one pattern.
explanation.direct: Blocked script practice left recognition undertrained because the category kept arriving pre-labeled.
explanation.competitive: The order was doing too much of the thinking for them.

questions.prompt: Why can mixed practice feel worse while still teaching more?
choices: Because it destroys all pattern and structure
Because it forces comparison and choice instead of one repeated rhythm
Because learners should avoid smooth sessions entirely

explanation.gentle: The session feels rougher because the learner has to compare and select rather than continue one familiar move.
explanation.direct: Interleaving often feels less fluent because it exposes the recognition work blocked practice can hide.
explanation.competitive: It costs the block's cheap rhythm and replaces it with real classification.

questions.prompt: Which idea would the chapter reject?
choices: Interleaving means disciplined variation
Blocked practice can sometimes have local value
Any random variety automatically improves learning

explanation.gentle: The chapter does not confuse productive mixing with random chaos.
explanation.direct: Variation helps when it sharpens comparison, not when it erases the pattern.
explanation.competitive: Noise is not instruction just because it looks less tidy.

questions.prompt: Why might rotating three similar musical passages help Leah more than repeating one?
choices: It weakens her memory so she stays humble
It forces her to compare the passages and choose the fitting movement
It guarantees the practice session will sound polished

explanation.gentle: The rotation builds recognition of what changes from one passage to the next.
explanation.direct: Interleaving can strengthen flexible performance by requiring comparison among near-neighbor cases.
explanation.competitive: The chooser gets stronger when the pattern stops repeating in one safe loop.

questions.prompt: Why does the next chapter need to broaden the discussion after interleaving?
choices: Because mixed practice is no longer useful
Because the book now needs a larger rule for when difficult learning helps
Because blocked practice is stronger than retrieval and interleaving together

explanation.gentle: Chapter 4 widens the lens from one useful difficulty to the broader idea of desirable difficulties.
explanation.direct: Interleaving is one case of hard-feeling learning that can help, so the next chapter asks for the broader principle.
explanation.competitive: Once mixing works, the book has to build a bigger difficulty filter.

questions.prompt: Why does mixed practice support transfer?
choices: Because it keeps the same move active longer
Because it asks the learner to classify and choose under changing conditions
Because it removes the need for repetition

explanation.gentle: Transfer improves when the learner practices recognizing which tool fits which changing case.
explanation.direct: Interleaving supports transfer by making category recognition and response selection part of the training.
explanation.competitive: Later performance is mixed, so practice that trains choice under mixed conditions travels farther.

questions.prompt: What keeps variation productive rather than chaotic?
choices: The practice keeps enough structure for comparison to teach
The learner stops making errors
The session feels smooth again

explanation.gentle: Variation helps when the learner can still compare cases clearly enough to see what matters.
explanation.direct: Interleaving works only when the pattern remains legible enough for discrimination to sharpen.
explanation.competitive: Keep the hinge visible. Once the pattern disappears, the drill becomes fog.
